summary: Frontend-only retest of the AdminClients (/admin/clients) balance block after the pre-Sunday revert. Logged in as admin, rendered all 118 active clients and scanned the DOM: the amber 'Por facturar' pill and the combined 'Deuda Total' block are fully gone (0 occurrences of the text, 0 'pending-to-invoice-*' and 0 'total-debt-*' testids) in both Activos and Inhabilitados tabs. All 118 cards render exactly one 'pending-balance-{customer_id}' block: 60 red 'Total a Pagar' (pending_balance<0), 5 green 'Saldo a Favor' with '+$X' (pending_balance>0), 53 gray 'Total a Pagar' $0.00 — no label/sign mismatches. Seed client C5557 (has pending_to_invoice>0 in backend) shows only the red card 'Total a Pagar $289.09' with bg-red-50/text-red-600 and no pill. Regression: Inhabilitar, Factura, Recalcular, Diagnóstico and Editar buttons all visible/enabled; the Diagnóstico modal (client-diagnostics-dialog) opens and renders real data from /admin/clients/{customer_id}/diagnostics (Facturas 4, Compras 20, Recargas 24, Envíos 1). No console/JS errors, no .error elements.

issues: Decorative background hero image shows through behind the client list/footer area, slightly reducing readability of the empty space below the list (cosmetic, pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: AdminClients.jsx lines 678-686 now derive the card purely from client.pending_balance — correct and consistent with the requested pre-Sunday behavior; client.pending_to_invoice is no longer referenced in this file.

Other screens still surface 'Por facturar' (AdminInvoices.jsx:906, AdminLive.jsx:1251-1255 'Deuda Total' badge, AdminStats.jsx kpi-pending-to-invoice). If the revert was meant to be app-wide, these need the same treatment; per the review request scope they were left as-is.
AdminClients.jsx is 1154 lines — consider splitting dialogs (invoice/edit/diagnostics) into separate components.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminClients balance block verified fixed (no 'Por facturar' pill, no 'Deuda Total'). Data distribution in seed: 60 clients negative balance, 5 positive, 53 zero; C5557 = -289.09 and has pending purchases in backend. 'Por facturar' still rendered in AdminInvoices, AdminLive and AdminStats — confirm with the user whether those are in scope before flagging as bugs. Header logo 404 is pre-existing.
rca_of_the_issue: The pill originated from AdminClients.jsx rendering client.pending_to_invoice (a field still returned by the backend). The fix removes that rendering; the backend field remains but is unused in this view, so nothing can reappear in the client list.
